topic: Can satellite orbital configurations optimize ML-based QoS by reducing propagation delays for latency-sensitive traffic classes?
consensus_response: Satellite communication inherently faces fixed latencies due to the unique nature of satellite links. Traditional QoS mechanisms like DiffServ and RSVP fail to address this as they focus on capacity management, neglecting latency dynamics inherent in satellite networks.  Advanced path selection algorithms leveraging ML can predict signal degradation due to atmospheric conditions, allowing for dynamic adjustments that prioritize critical traffic classes while minimizing delays. This approach optimizes QoS performance by considering both bandwidth availability and fixed latencies.
